server.name: io.github.TradeRouter/trade-router-mcp
server.description: TradeRouter.ai MCP Server — Solana swap & limit order engine.

environmentVariables.description: Solana wallet private key in base58 format. Required for auto-signing transactions and WebSocket authentication.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC endpoint URL. Defaults to https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com if not set.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: TradeRouter server public key (base58) used to verify server signatures. Defaults to the hardcoded trust anchor.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_SERVER_PUBKEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional next/rotated TradeRouter server public key (base58) for key rotation support.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_SERVER_PUBKEY_NEXT

environmentVariables.description: Whether to require server signature verification on filled orders. Defaults to true.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_REQUIRE_SERVER_SIGNATURE

environmentVariables.description: Whether to require server signature verification on order creation. Defaults to true.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_REQUIRE_ORDER_CREATED_SIGNATURE

server.name: io.github.TradeRouter/trade-router-mcp
server.description: Non-custodial Solana swap & limit order engine for AI agents.

environmentVariables.description: Solana base58-encoded private key. Local signing only, never transmitted. See SECURITY.md.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional RPC endpoint override (default https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com).
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the server public key used to verify order_filled ed25519 signatures.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_SERVER_PUBKEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional second server public key accepted during key rotation.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_SERVER_PUBKEY_NEXT

environmentVariables.description: Default 'true'. Verify server signatures on order_filled / twap_execution.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_REQUIRE_SERVER_SIGNATURE

environmentVariables.description: Default 'true'. Verify server signatures on order_created.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_REQUIRE_ORDER_CREATED_SIGNATURE

server.name: io.github.TradeRouter/trade-router-mcp
server.description: Non-custodial Solana swap & limit order engine for AI agents.

environmentVariables.description: Solana base58-encoded private key. Local signing only, never transmitted. See SECURITY.md.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional RPC endpoint override (default https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com).
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the server public key used to verify order_filled ed25519 signatures.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_SERVER_PUBKEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional second server public key accepted during key rotation.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_SERVER_PUBKEY_NEXT

environmentVariables.description: Default 'true'. Verify server signatures on order_filled / twap_execution.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_REQUIRE_SERVER_SIGNATURE

environmentVariables.description: Default 'true'. Verify server signatures on order_created.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_REQUIRE_ORDER_CREATED_SIGNATURE

environmentVariables.description: Default 'false'. When 'true', write-action tools (submit_signed_swap, auto_swap, place_*_order, cancel_order, extend_order) short-circuit and return { dry_run: true, ... } instead of calling the API. Read-only tools execute normally.
environmentVariables.name: TRADEROUTER_DRY_RUN
